**SpaceX’s Starship – the latest launch updates (Sept 28 2026)**  

- **First orbital test flight:** After 13 sub‑orbital demonstration flights, Starship will attempt its **first orbit** on **Sept 28, 2026**.  
  ![CNN](https://imgs.search.brave.com/KxiwaP63PwX7n8u5Wb63xZ2830qhsyL81bdbl3ziWGQ/rs:fit:200:200:1:0/g:ce/aHR0cHM6Ly9tZWRp/YS5jbm4uY29tL2Fw/aS92MS9pbWFnZXMv/c3RlbGxhci9wcm9k/LzIwMjYtMDctMjV0/MDEwNjAzei0xNzUy/NjQ3NDQyLXJjMmhr/bWFya2tybC1ydHJt/YWRwLTMtc3BhY2Ut/c3BhY2V4LXN0YXJz/aGlwLTIwMjYwOTI1/MjAxMjI3NjY2Lmpw/Zz9jPTE2eDkmcT13/XzgwMCxjX2ZpbGw)  
  *Source:* [CNN – “SpaceX’s Starship is headed for orbit”](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/27/science/spacex-starship-orbital-launch)

- **Launch time:** Liftoff is set for **8:15 a.m. EDT (1215 GMT)**.  
  ![Space.com](https://imgs.search.brave.com/57kUO-zL-WNDA6dORIEu5KjGgonacxziBozm76FV_jM/rs:fit:200:200:1:0/g:ce/aHR0cHM6Ly9jZG4u/bW9zLmNtcy5mdXR1/cmVjZG4ubmV0L2Rm/TGFuM0VvWml3dEFB/anZvU1I4S0stMjU2/MC04MC5qcGc)  
  *Source:* [Space.com – “Starship megarocket launching to orbit for 1st time ever today”](https://www.space.com/space-exploration/launches-spacecraft/spacexs-starship-megarocket-launching-to-orbit-for-1st-time-ever-on-sept-28-watch-it-live)

- **FAA approval:** SpaceX received its **final Flight 14 (IFT‑14) launch and landing test** clearance from the FAA.  
  ![Tesla Oracle](https://imgs.search.brave.com/IZO95YZePwwbmylp3X69Zzd4e6JDh9t-uo4G1DQjiac/rs:fit:200:200:1:0/g:ce/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cu/dGVzbGFvcmFjbGUu/Y29tL3dwLWNvbnRl/bnQvdXBsb2Fkcy8y/MDI2LzA5L0Z1bGx5/LUludGVncmF0ZWQt/RmxpZ2h0LTE0LVN0/YXJzaGlwLVN0YXJi/YXNlLVRvd2VyLmpw/Zw)  
  *Source:* [Tesla Oracle – “SpaceX completes Starship Flight 14 launch rehearsal, gets final FAA approval”](https://teslaoracle.com/2026/09/27/spacex-completes-starship-flight-14-launch-rehearsal-gets-final-faa-approval-for-launch-on-monday-more)

- **Revenue expectations:** The orbital test is projected to **start generating revenue** for SpaceX after the earlier profit‑draining demos.  
  ![Motley Fool](https://imgs.search.brave.com/zdwVHFiwVztk1iZalU90vC6jooQjCKWqV33qlGXW09U/rs:fit:200:200:1:0/g:ce/aHR0cHM6Ly9nLmZv/b2xjZG4uY29tL2lt/YWdlLz91cmw9aHR0/cHMlM0ElMkYlMkZn/LmZvb2xjZG4uY29t/JTJGZWRpdG9yaWFs/JTJGaW1hZ2VzJTJG/ODg4MjY4JTJGYXJ0/aXN0cy1kZXBpY3Rp/b24tb2Ytc3RhcnNo/aXAtbGVhdmluZy1l/YXJ0aC1vcmJpdC5q/cGcmYW1wO3c9MTIw/MCZhbXA7b3A9cmVz/aXpl)  
  *Source:* [The Motley Fool – “SpaceX's Next Starship Launch Will Generate Revenue”](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/09/27/spacexs-next-starship-launch-will-generate-revenue/)

- **Mission profile:** The 14th test flight aims for a **10‑hour spaceflight**, circling the globe **six times**.  
  ![Mashable](https://imgs.search.brave.com/csK3WsZ-yvS_23X2rwanK5fxtCacVVWNZqnVuSnIRL0/rs:fit:200:200:1:0/g:ce/aHR0cHM6Ly9oZWxp/b3MtaS5tYXNoYWJs/ZS5jb20vaW1hZ2Vy/eS9hcnRpY2xlcy8w/MjVydUZ5VVJDY2xu/TGpraHpQVHZzOC9o/ZXJvLWltYWdlLmZp/bGwuc2l6ZV8xMjAw/eDY3NS52MTc5MDM2/ODQ4Mi5qcGc)  
  *Source:* [Mashable – “SpaceX's Starship is about to attempt a 10‑hour spaceflight”](https://mashable.com/science/spacex-starship-livestream-september-2026)

- **Market reaction:** SPCX stock reflects **high growth expectations** ahead of the launch.  
  ![GuruFocus](https://imgs.search.brave.com/g0HYWIHdkpo35IEOHtO3Qs4-6xL6iRw4ktAHlqYJxwY/rs:fit:200:200:1:0/g:ce/aHR0cHM6Ly9zdGF0/aWMuZ3VydWZvY3Vz/LmNvbS9pbWFnZXMv/Z2xvYmFsX2xvZ29f/dHdpdHRlcl9jYXJk/LnBuZw)  
  *Source:* [GuruFocus – “SpaceX’s Starship Set for First Orbital Launch Monday”](https://gurufocus.com/news/9099274/spacexs-starship-set-for-first-orbital-launch-monday-spcx-stock-reflects-high-growth-expectations)

- **Local impact:** Residents near Texas’ southern coast report the **earth‑shattering roar** and anticipate possible **seismic effects** from the massive rocket.
